title: Contractor Kit Pricing for Northgate Business Members on Northgate Delivery & Installation
content:
On a Northgate Delivery & Installation installation appointment, the kit price for each installation parts kit follows the membership presented on the purchase and the member's recent appliance buying.

- **Membership presented** — the tier of the membership recorded on the purchase being delivered, as Northgate Memberships records it.
- **Recent appliance buying** — the major appliance units the member bought on any purchase less those returned, a line counting only when fewer than twelve whole months separate its posting date from today, as the member's purchase lines under Northgate Purchases & Returns show them.

| Membership presented | Major appliance units bought in the last twelve whole months, less those returned | Kit price for each kit |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Business Membership or Northgate Business Plus Membership | 4 or more | Contractor price of $27.99 |
| Northgate Business Membership or Northgate Business Plus Membership | Fewer than 4 | Contractor price of $33.99 |
| Any other membership | Any number | The service level's installation parts kit fee |

## Cases (hypothetical members)

- A Northgate Business Plus Membership whose member bought 5 major appliance units in the last twelve whole months and returned 1 has 4 units: $27.99 a kit.
- The same membership with 3 units: $33.99 a kit.
- A Northgate Club Plus Membership with 6 units: the service level's installation parts kit fee, because only the two Business tiers take the contractor price.
- Units bought 12 whole months ago or earlier do not count; units bought 11 whole months ago count.

The units counted are those on all of the member's purchases, not only the purchase being delivered.
